specialProcessList.publicDescription: Direct to Garment (DTG) printing uses water-based inks that absorb into the fabric, creating a soft, breathable feel. It is ideal for natural-looking designs with smooth gradients, subtle textures, and fine details, offering a more blended, fabric-like appearance.

Direct to Film (DTF) printing delivers vibrant, highly saturated colors with strong opacity. It is ideal for high-contrast designs and solid graphics. The print forms a thin film layer on the fabric, resulting in sharp details, though large areas may feel less breathable and gradients may appear less smooth.
Embroidery adds a premium, textured finish to garments with durable and intricate stitching, perfect for logos and badges, and maintains a professional appearance.
